description: GaWF-aligned RNN behavioral control: identity inner activation and the LayerNorm/ReLU/dropout output fed back as the next recurrent state, ten seeds.

The original lanes use the runner's completed-output guard and will skip seeds5-10 training once their valid final artifacts exist.
dependency_strategy.amarel_handoff: 61760273 and 61760274 cancelled after DSW formal seeds1-2 entered epoch 1

notes: Formal hyperparameters reuse the old RNN setting exactly: hidden_size=275, lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-5, cnn_dropout=0.0, rnn_dropout=0.5, AdamW, 150 epochs, patience=0, seeds 1-10.
Core equation: pre_t=W_ih x_t+b_ih+W_hh h_(t-1)+b_hh; h_t=dropout(ReLU(LayerNorm(pre_t))). h_t is both the layer output and the next recurrent state; there is no inner tanh.
The model key and checkpoint stem are rnn_inloop_notanh, intentionally distinct from the cancelled out-of-loop rnn_notanh control.
